text: Appeal of Dangerous Dog Order issued, October 12, 2023, Appeal DDRT2023-29.

The Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal: 1. Rescinded the determination of a dangerous dog and exempt the applicant from compliance with the Dangerous Dog Order issued October 12, 2023, under file DDRT 2023-29, as there is consent from both parties under file DDRT 2023-29, being the appellant Joanne Blanchette, and their Representative, and the City of Toronto through the Executive Director, Municipal Licensing and Standards, and their Representative.
